name: Warung Luminescence → Flip of the Coin — v2 (Tighter Handoff)
description: v2: Shorter overlap to avoid energy dip. v1 was smooth but got quiet in the middle. Tighter 12-bar overlap starting later (Warung 228-240). Warung melody is already gone by 224, so this is kick-only territory. Flip enters at bar 0, gets 12 bars of buildup, and hits bar 12 (where mids are developing) right as Warung exits. Faster automation + bass EQ keeps energy up.

tracks.name: Warung - Luminescence
tracks.notes: 3A (Bb minor). Melody gone by bar 224. Kick/bass only bars 224-239.

tracks.name: Flip of the Coin (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 4A (F minor). Kick from bar 0, mids build at 8, DROP at 24.

transitions.notes: v2: 12-bar overlap (Warung 228-240, Flip 0-12). Warung is purely kick/bass here — melody long gone. Flip is in sparse intro territory (just kick + minimal texture). Bass EQ on Flip prevents dual-kick, faster automation keeps energy from dipping. Crossover at overlap bar 6 instead of v1's bar 16.
